title: Al-Haqqah 69:45-52 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Haqqah; noon and meem recap and when letters meet
source: Written for quran/y8 lesson 20 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Haqqah 69:45-52 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 20. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ (٤٥) ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ (٤٦) فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَٰجِزِينَ (٤٧) وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌۭ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ (٤٨) وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ (٤٩) وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ (٥٠) وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ (٥١) فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ (٥٢)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: We would have seized him by the right hand;
Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous.
And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Haqqah 69:45-52 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 69:45-52 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 69:45-52 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Write where Muslims say 'Subhana Rabbiyal-'Adheem' and why it links to 69:52.
questions.a: In ruku' of salah; it glorifies Allah, the Most Great, as 69:52 commands.

questions.q: Recite the whole of Al-Haqqah (52 ayat).
questions.a: All 52 ayat with no more than three prompts.

options: glorify the name of our Lord, the Most Great
questions.a: A) glorify the name of our Lord, the Most Great. 'So glorify the name of your Lord, the Most Great' (69:52).

questions.q: Think again: The surah ends with 'So glorify the name of your Lord, the Most Great'. After everything in Al-Haqqah, why end with tasbih?
questions.a: Because the truth of the Qur'an and the Day is certain (69:51); the right response is to glorify Allah (69:52).
